note: THE FLOOR the differential surface may not fall below, in TRANSACTIONS and in
IMPLEMENTATION-PAIR COMPARISONS. Not a target and not a measurement: a ratchet. Coverage that
shrinks silently is the failure this file exists to prevent, and it has a precedent — the arm

Raising it is free. Lowering it must be deliberate and must say why in the commit message,
which is the whole point of it being a checked-in number rather than a computed one.
